summary: State-machine image texture decoder protected by a setjmp/longjmp dispatch block. Decodes a streaming texture into a per-object pixel buffer, supporting format 50 (raw row copy) and format 22 (24-bit RGB unpacked from the stream into 16-bit pixels). Allocates the destination pixel buffer on first decode unless the palette-only flag at this+0x40 is set, in which case pixel decode is skipped.

operations.description: Initialize the state-machine block by calling sub_51177C(v19) and storing its return value in v22; this function is entered from DirectXSurfaceFormatNegotiation.
Install the setjmp/longjmp recovery vtable: v19[0] = VTableDispatchWithLongjmp and v20 = nullsub_4.
setjmp guard: Setjmp3MSVCJmpBufSave(v21, 0, v17); a nonzero result branches to the teardown/error label, skipping the decode body.
sub_50F632(&v22, 61, 424) initializes the dispatch state machine with state 61 and buffer capacity 424.

Allocate a new dispatch object via the state-machine allocator (v23)(&v22, 0, 36) and fill its vtable: entry 0 = 0, entry 1 = 0, entry 2 = nullsub_4, entry 3 = loc_5016FC, entry 4 = BufferPointerAdjust, entry 5 = AudioVideoDecodeSubbandLoop, entry 6 = nullsub_4, entry 7 = a2 (source pointer), entry 8 = a3 (destination).
Guard on the result of sub_50FC7D(); when it returns zero set v25 = 1 as a side-state flag.
Swap the dispatch thunk: v20 = VtableDispatchThunk.
Run the state machine to completion: StateMachineWithDispatch(&v22).
Decoded-state guard: when v28 == 1 select the format 50 path, setting this[0] = 50 and this[0x30] = v26 (row width/stride).
Palette flag guard: read this[0x40]; when non-zero the function skips pixel-buffer allocation and the decode loops entirely.
Shared decode init: this[0x34] = 0, this[0xC] = width, this[0x10] = height, this[0x14] = 1.
When this[0x40] == 0: set this[0x38] = 1 and allocate the pixel buffer via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(height * width), storing the pointer in this[0x4]; on allocation failure return -2147024882.
Format 50 (raw RGBA) path: when this[0] == 50, stream each row via StreamBufferReadStateMachine(&v22, v31, 1) and copy v26 bytes per row into the buffer, advancing the destination by v26 each row.

Format 22 (RGB unpack) path: when this[0] == 22, stream each row via StreamBufferReadStateMachine and convert each 3-byte RGB source tuple into a packed 16-bit pixel stored into the destination buffer.
Decoded-state guard: when v28 == 3 select the format 22 setup path, setting this[0] = 22 and this[0x30] = 4 * v26 (expanded row stride), then fall through to the shared decode init.
Return 0 for a completed decode; the error label returns -2147467259; the buffer failure path returns -2147024882.
Teardown on every exit path: VTableDtorNullFields(&v22) frees the dispatch block before the return value is propagated.
